entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes, delivered 17 days ago. I also see you're a VIP member with us, thank you for your loyalty. So, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They don't work. They're giving me blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that; that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Is it a specific spot where they're rubbing, or is it an overall fit issue? Sometimes adjusting the cleats can change how your foot sits in the shoe.
I've moved the cleats. It doesn't matter. They're just not right. I need to get a refund.

Of course, I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you... Yes, it looks like you're well within our 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this for you. I'll email a pre-paid return label to you right now.
Fine. So I just ship them back?

That's right. And for the trouble with the blisters and since you're a VIP, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 store credit to your account. I hope that helps you find a pair of cycling shoes that work much better for you on your next order.
Whatever. I guess that's something. Just make sure I get the email.

I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox shortly. As soon as we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better day.
